name.value: Christina Lake Motel and RV Park

description.value: Christina Lake Motel and RV Park is a year-round, pet-friendly property on the shores of Christina Lake in BC's Boundary region, offering newly renovated motel rooms with kitchenettes and air conditioning alongside 48 RV sites and 7 tent sites. The property is steps from the lake and within reach of local biking trails, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring the area. A food truck (The Fork In The Road Food Bus) appears in their on-site gallery, suggesting casual dining options close at hand.

address.value: 19 West Lake Drive, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms OSM contact details (address, phone, website). Free Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed across multiple pages for both motel and RV park guests.

Gallery lists 'The Fork In The Road Food Bus' as an apparent on-site food option, but this is not described in any page text — unclear if it is a permanent fixture or seasonal/occasional.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active accommodation near biking trails that would benefit touring cyclists, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is mentioned anywhere on the website — direct confirmation is needed before listing.
